introduce.metaTitle: Oyscat | AI Electrified Making System – Where Creation Begins
introduce.metaDescription: Oyscat by QiCore is an AI electrified making system: generate models from a single sentence or build with standard electronic modules, program in natural language, validate in simulation, then assemble the real thing with 3D-printed or handmade enclosures.
introduce.metaKeywords: Oyscat, AI making, AI electrified making system, electronic modules, AI modeling, natural language programming, simulation, 3D printing, maker community, QiCore
introduce.ogImageAlt: Oyscat: Focus on what you want to make, not what you know.
introduce.description: Make creation simpler. Turn hardware, crafts and everyday objects into creations of your own.
introduce.overviewTitle: Give every idea a place to begin.
introduce.libraryDescription: Organize your creations and save snapshots along the way, keeping a record of every experiment.
introduce.workspaceDescription: Bring parts, structures and code together in one workspace as your ideas take shape.
introduce.docsDescription: From getting started to module references, find what you need for your next creation.
introduce.betaBanner: Oyscat Workspace public beta coming soon
